name: prompt-master
description: Generate, fix, improve, adapt, and optimize production-ready prompts for coding agents, LLMs, image, video, search, automation, and other AI tools.

interface.longDescription: Prompt Master identifies the target AI tool, extracts intent, asks only critical clarifying questions, selects an appropriate prompt architecture, applies tool-specific constraints, and produces a concise copy-ready prompt.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me write or improve a prompt for an AI tool.
